title: CBOFS sea surface height (ROMS curvilinear, kerchunk-indexed)
description:
NOAA/NOS Chesapeake Bay Operational Forecast System (CBOFS), published via NODD's rolling kerchunk Zarr V3 index. The pointer at `zarr3/cbofs/refs/main.json` names the current publication's `zarr_uri`; resolved at build time to publication `20261105T194935Z-a52a` (**this URL rotates on every model cycle** -- it will not be the same tomorrow). The store is ROMS/TOMS output, SGRID-0.3 convention: a 2-D curvilinear grid (`lat_rho`/`lon_rho`, each [eta_rho, xi_rho], float64, no CRS/grid_mapping variable at all) rather than a regular or affine-mapped grid. `zeta` (free-surface / sea surface height) is [ocean_time, eta_rho, xi_rho], shape [769, 291, 332], chunks [14, 73, 166], zstd. bbox is an estimate for Chesapeake Bay (the actual footprint requires reading the full lat_rho/lon_rho arrays, not just their metadata).

License: NOAA operational model output, public domain (US government work).

Expected browser outcome: refused with a clear notice -- no affine transform and 2-D (non-1-D) spatial coordinates, which this browser's Zarr map support does not handle.
